data.description:
## What
Update the existing test `test_pr_deep_tier_parallel_specialists_dispatched` in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py`.

## Why this update is needed
The existing test fixture sets `security_overlay: True` (approximately line 349) but asserts that exactly 3 agents are dispatched (the 3 deep specialists). Once the GREEN task (6420-5d7f) implements overlay dispatch, the security overlay agent (`code-reviewer-security-red-team`) will also be dispatched, breaking the `assert len(captured_agents) == 3` assertion.

This test is about deep-tier parallel dispatch, not overlay dispatch. The fix is to set `security_overlay: False` in the fixture so the test remains focused on its original intent.

## Change
In `test_pr_deep_tier_parallel_specialists_dispatched`:
- Change `'security_overlay': True` → `'security_overlay': False` in the tier_result fixture (approximately line 349)
- The assertion `len(captured_agents) == 3` and the `agent_ids` assertions stay unchanged

## Files to Modify
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py (1-line change)

## Acceptance Criteria
- `python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py::test_pr_deep_tier_parallel_specialists_dispatched` passes after GREEN task (6420-5d7f) is implemented
- No other tests changed in this task

## Testing Mode
UPDATE — fixes a test that would break after GREEN implementation

## File Impact
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py (modify, 1 line)
data.title: UPDATE: fix test_pr_deep_tier_parallel_specialists_dispatched fixture — set security_overlay=False to isolate tier dispatch test
